name: Switch
hint: Toggle it. Click anywhere on the row.
description: On/off setting with label and description. Under the `porcelain` preset the on track is green with a white thumb. The thumb stretches as it travels and settles with a squash; the whole row is clickable. role=switch, with a hidden checkbox that carries the value in a form.
intents: toggle a setting on or off
usage: Use for a setting that takes effect as soon as it flips (notifications, dark mode). Give it `label` (and `description` if it needs one), then either `checked` + `onChange` (controlled) or `defaultChecked` (it keeps its own state). Inside a <form>, set `name` and the value is submitted like a checkbox. Pass `bordered={false}` for plain rows in a list, `showRow={false}` with `aria-label` (or `label`, which then becomes the accessible name) for a bare switch, and `error` for a message you already have. If the choice only applies after a Save button, a switch reads wrong: say so in the label or description, or use a Checkbox, the kit's control for a choice that applies when a form is saved. The on track uses the preset's on-state colour (green in `porcelain`; presets without one use their accent). The thumb takes the surface colour in every preset. Porcelain's green is under 3:1 against its light canvas by choice: the thumb's position carries the state.

keyboard.does: Turns the switch on or off.

screenReader: A switch named by `label` (or `aria-label` when there is no row), with `description` read after it; it says on or off as it changes. With `error` it is marked invalid and the message is read as its description.

dataProps.description: Controlled state. Pass it with onChange and the switch shows exactly this. Leave undefined to let the switch keep its own state.
Starting state when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to.
(checked: boolean, event) => void, on every toggle (and on form reset if the state changes).
Form field name. The hidden checkbox submits `value` under this name when on, nothing when off.
Id for the switch button (and the base for its label and description ids).
The form will not submit while the switch is off (native validation).
An error you already have, shown under the label and announced.
Draw the labelled row as a bordered card. false gives a plain row for lists of settings.
Widest the labelled row grows, in px. 0 lets it fill its container.
Goes to the switch <button>, for focus().
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<Switch
  label="Weekly digest"
  description="Mentions, replies and what shipped."
  name="digest"
  checked={digest}
  onChange={setDigest}
  bordered={false}
  maxWidth={0}
/>
